method.counts: Static instruction sites across a whole function or largest backwards-branch address span; nops excluded. No execution-frequency weighting.
method.stack: Direct rsp/rbp memory operands excluding lea. General source/destination fields are AT&T operand positions, not scalar read/write semantics; vector read/write sites additionally need a v-prefixed mnemonic and explicit SIMD operand. Other-register stack aliases are not tracked. Scratch arrays, argument homes and spills are not distinguished.
method.loop: Largest direct backwards jump address span; includes alternative/guarded basic blocks and inner loops. Not a dynamic per-iteration instruction count.
method.simd: Maximum explicit SIMD operand width, not useful lanes, uops, utilization or memory traffic. Register indices merge xmm/ymm/zmm aliases.
method.pressure: Register references and stack sites do not measure peak liveness, physical rename-register occupancy, dynamic spill rate or stalls.
method.avx2_comparison: AVX2 dual-row functions take runtime nt; NT4/NT8 calls share one function. Whole-function footprint is not a specialized execution path.
method.object_provenance: Hashes identify the inspected objects. Correspondence with every older timed executable is not independently established.
